help.title: Help
help.directory.title: Official help directory
help.directory.subtitle: Saved on this phone. Phone numbers work without map tiles or internet data.
help.emergency.call911: In an emergency, call 9-1-1. Dry Run never calls anyone for you.
help.rehearsal.noAutoCall: Practice scenario: no calls are placed during a rehearsal.
help.directions.privacy: Directions send the destination and your location to Apple, not to Dry Run. Map directions do not confirm a road is safe or open.
help.freshness.expired: Information may be out of date (expired {date})
help.freshness.demo: Demo data - not a real alert or service
help.review.needsReview: Not yet reviewed by a person
help.coverage.verifiedPartial: Some local contacts checked against official pages
help.coverage.oemOnly: Only the county emergency office is listed
help.coverage.notStarted: Local contacts not yet added. Use 2-1-1 or your county's official website.
help.activation.unconfirmed: Activation not confirmed. Check with the official source before going.
help.activation.confirmedActive: Open according to the official source (until {date})
help.activation.confirmedInactive: Closed according to the official source
help.alerts.title: Current official alerts
help.alerts.none: No current official alerts for this area from the National Weather Service.
help.alerts.unavailable: Current conditions are unavailable right now. Your rehearsals and saved plans still work offline.
help.alerts.stale: Last updated {time}. This may no longer be current.
help.stear.title: STEAR registry (optional)
help.stear.body: STEAR is a voluntary Texas registry. Information you give it is shared with local emergency planners and responders. Registering does not guarantee that you will receive help. Dry Run does not register you and never sends your household profile.
help.stear.how: To register, dial 2-1-1, choose your language, then Option 4, or visit stear.texas.gov.
help.211.body: 2-1-1 Texas: dial 2-1-1 or 877-541-7905, choose your language, then Option 1 for services in your area.
help.fema.body: FEMA financial assistance is available only in presidentially declared disaster areas, and not everyone qualifies for every program. Many fires and outages are not declared disasters.
help.flood.fixture: Flood map context is not available in this version. Flood maps show mapped hazard, not current flooding or safe roads.
help.privacy.boundary: Your household profile and home layout stay on this phone. Opening a website, calling, or getting directions leaves Dry Run.
